critic_network:
Sequential(
  (0): Linear(in_features=780, out_features=512, bias=True)

  (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)

dagger_samples: all teacher and student trajectories, elementwise mean MSE
gru_saturation_definition: fraction of sampled elements with abs(value) >= 0.9999
loss_schedule: alpha ramps PPO surrogate and entropy from ppo_initial_coeff to 1; critic remains unscaled; lambda anneals MSE independently; both use restored update_iteration, with no automatic performance gating
objective_gradient_probe: first minibatch before each update: raw and alpha-weighted PPO surrogate (excluding entropy), lambda-weighted MSE; cosine uses raw PPO vs weighted MSE
ppo_gradient_path: raw observations -> encoders -> GRU -> actor (no detached features)
rollout_std: learnable log_std, initial std from policy config
student_network:
CR1RecurrentVisualPpoStudent(
  (proprio_encoder): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=2125, out_features=512, bias=True)
    (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (4): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (layer_norm): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  )
  (depth_encoder): CR1RecurrentDepthEncoder(
    (convolutions): Sequential(
      (0): Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=(8, 8), stride=(4, 4))
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (2): Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=(4, 4), stride=(2, 2))
      (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (4): Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(2, 2))
      (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (6): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (projection): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=768, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (layer_norm): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
    )
  )
  (gru): GRU(256, 256)
  (recurrent_projection): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  )
  (feature_mlp): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=341, out_features=2048, bias=True)
    (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (2): Linear(in_features=2048, out_features=1024, bias=True)
    (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (4): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=512, bias=True)
    (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (6): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (7): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  )
  (action_head): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=25, bias=True)
)
timeout_bootstrap: RSL current value bootstrap; exclude simultaneous true termination
